title: Binary point from free signs
statement: For every $n$, every set $J$ of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and every assignment $y$ of signs to the coordinates in $J$, combine $y$ with the constant $+1$ assignment on the remaining coordinates and convert the resulting sign vector to a binary vector. This binary vector is the indicator vector, over $\mathbb F_2$, of the set of coordinates in $J$ where $y$ equals $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$y$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $J$
